notes: Form 1040 line 25a: 'Add the amounts shown as federal income tax withheld on your Form(s) W-2. The amount withheld should be shown in box 2 of Form W-2' (i1040gi-2025 l.2551-2556). v2 published only when the number of current W-2 box-2 statements equaled the number of W-2 box-1 statements. v3 replaces that comparison with require_paired on the w2-slip key: every current box-1 row has a current box-2 row on the same slip. Both family closures stay inside the arm. A missing box 2 blocks DEPENDENCY_ABSENT naming tax.us.2025.w2.box2-withholding. A $0 row counts because the row exists. A box-2 row with no box-1 row is not a failure. The aggregation itself (value) is collect+add+round over the box-2 family, same shape as box 1's own rule.wages-line1a. This version requires tax.us.2025.w2.closure-check so that closure is named before the guard runs. The expression does not read the symbol.
